surfaces.condition: A repository is added, removed, reclassified, or its catalog freshness, source commit, or visibility policy changes.
validation: Refresh from Pronto's read-only registered-repository inventory and verify one row per registered repository.
Validate schema, duplicate identities, freshness states, visibility policies, current-row requirements, and private URL boundaries.
Keep missing, needs_review, stale, blocked, and unknown evidence distinct from fully_private; do not infer privacy from absence of provider evidence.

surfaces.condition: The profile README or the catalog's README-eligibility policy changes.
validation: Verify the catalog hash, source commit, inventory observation time, and rendered-entry count marker agree.
Verify every current public or explicitly approved private_readme_allowed row is rendered exactly once.
Verify fully_private, missing, stale, and needs_review rows are excluded; private README-allowed rows never emit a private URL automatically.
Verify Public Releases remains a flat table and other catalog sections support category and subcategory disclosure, including Product Work > Developer Tooling > Agent-enabled.

surfaces.condition: Catalog refresh, README generation, or profile publication workflow changes.
validation: Document the source inventory, read-only refresh boundary, freshness window, and exact command used to render the README.
Keep source/local inventory, provider visibility, README eligibility, and published profile readback as separate evidence lanes.

surfaces.condition: Any profile catalog or renderer behavior changes.
